---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
labels: enhancement
---

## What you want

The feature or change you're proposing, in one or two sentences.

## Why

What problem does it solve, or what's the use case? Concrete is better than abstract.

## Alternatives you considered

Other ways you could solve the same problem (including doing nothing).

## Scope check

- [ ] Fits within Chronicle's "local-only, transcripts stay on this Mac" privacy model
- [ ] Works on macOS 15+ (no older fallback needed)
- [ ] Doesn't require a paid backend service
